en.headline: Space Museum opens free exhibition on astronauts' life aboard Tiangong
en.dek: The display runs until 19 July next year and features a full-scale model of Hong Kong's first scientific payload on the station plus interactive exhibits.
body: The Hong Kong Space Museum has opened a free exhibition titled Reaching for the Cosmos: Astronauts' Log Aboard Tiangong. It runs from 25 November until 19 July next year and focuses on the work and daily life of astronauts on the station, including Hong Kong's first payload specialist Lai Ka-ying.

Exhibits include a replica of the Feitian extravehicular spacesuit, a full-scale model of the Multi-Spectral Imaging Carbon Observatory — the first locally developed scientific payload installed on Tiangong — and a mission patch signed by the Shenzhou-23 crew. Visitors can try operating a robotic arm through interactive displays and view multimedia programmes about life in orbit.
The museum said the exhibition also covers the Long March-2F rocket, the Shenzhou spacecraft and the roles of pilots, flight engineers and payload specialists. Admission is free.

zh.headline: 香港太空館舉辦免費展覽 展出航天員天宮日誌
zh.dek: 展覽即日起至明年7月19日，設有天韻相機全尺寸模型及互動機械臂體驗，介紹香港首位載荷專家黎家盈的任務。
body: 香港太空館即日起舉辦免費展覽「逐夢太空——航天員的天宮日誌」，展期至明年7月19日。展覽聚焦航天員在天宮太空站的工作與生活，包括香港首位載荷專家黎家盈的經歷。
展品包括「飛天」艙外航天服複製品、本港研發並安裝於天宮的多光譜成像碳觀測儀（天韻相機）全尺寸模型，以及神舟二十三號乘組簽名的任務徽章。參觀者可透過互動展項嘗試操作機械臂，並觀看有關軌道生活的多媒體節目。
太空館表示，展覽同時介紹長征二號F火箭、神舟飛船，以及航天駕駛員、飛行工程師和載荷專家的職責。入場免費。
